_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: William F. Fleming: Voltaire's Philosophical Dictionary (10 vols) and Works vol. IV, from the St. Hubert Guild Works of Voltaire (1901, intro. John Morley). US public domain. Round 163 (2026-10-23) added 13 volumes of the St. Hubert set, credited "Smollett, revised by Fleming", on Adam's ruling. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 27); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

_pending.fleming-st-hubert-rest: Adam ruled 2026-10-23 (decision card): shelve with honest credit, 'Smollett, revised by Fleming'. Round 163 shelved the 13 non-Dictionary volumes with Cornell scans (I, VIII, IX, XI-XIV, XVI-XXI). Not shelved: vols. III-VII (cu31924088380443, 450, 468, 476, 484), the Philosophical Dictionary, already here whole from Gutenberg (fle-35621..35630); vol. XXII (cu31924088380625), the index and Leigh's appreciation, not a translation. No Cornell scan found for vols. II, X and XV.
